guidance_fy26.status: UNVERIFIED — given on the Q2-26 earnings call (30-Jul-2026), not in any SEC filing (the 8-K Ex. 99.1 release has no outlook; slide decks are no longer furnished). Wording from third-party call transcripts (Yahoo Finance / Motley Fool / Globe and Mail / Investing.com) found by web search; investor.mastercard.com is not reachable from the build environment.
guidance_fy26.net_revenue: FY26 net revenue growth at the high end of a low-double-digits rate (raised: higher within the range than prior expectations), currency-neutral, excluding acquisitions; FX ~1 ppt tailwind. Q3-26: high end of low double digits currency-neutral ex-acquisitions.
guidance_fy26.opex: FY26 operating expense growth (adjusted, currency-neutral, ex-acquisitions) at a low-double-digits rate; FX 0.5–1 ppt headwind. Q3-26: low double digits.
guidance_fy26.other: Q3-26 other income (expense) about $(125)m excluding equity-investment gains/losses (higher interest after the June-2026 notes).
guidance_fy26.tax: Non-GAAP tax rate 20–21% for Q3 and Q4 2026.
guidance_fy26.model_rev_note: Model end-points (reported USD growth): currency-neutral 13.0 / 12.5 / 12.0% (high end of low double digits) + ~1 ppt FX = 14.0 / 13.5 / 13.0% (Bull / Base / Bear). H1-26 actual +15% reported, +12% currency-neutral.
guidance_fy26.model_opex_note: Model end-points for adjusted operating expense growth (reported USD): low double digits currency-neutral (~10–11%) + 0.5–1 ppt FX headwind = 11.0 / 11.5 / 12.0% (Bull = low end). H1-26 actual +11% reported, +9% currency-neutral.

bvnk.name: BVNK Holdings Limited (stablecoin payments infrastructure)
bvnk.status: Pending at 30-Jun-2026: agreement March 2026, 100% for $1.5bn plus up to $300m contingent consideration; expected to complete before the end of Q3-2026 (Q2-26 10-Q Note 2). Closing not yet reported in an SEC filing; the model assumes 30-Sep-2026 (assumption). Revenue, profit and PPA not disclosed.

debt.at_2026_06_30: Total debt $24,643m at 30-Jun-2026: senior notes $24,088m principal (29 USD / EUR tranches, 1.0–5.0% coupons, Nov-2026 to Mar-2051), commercial paper $710m (3.84%), less $134m discount / costs and $21m hedge adjustment. $8bn revolver to Nov-2030 undrawn; CP + revolver capacity $8bn combined.
debt.maturity_note: Principal by year (Q2-26 10-Q Note 9): Nov-2026 $750m (2.95%); 2027 $1,912m (Mar $1,000m 3.3%; Dec EUR $912m 2.1%); 2028 $4,500m (Jan $750m, Feb $500m, Mar $1,500m incl. $300m floating, Jun $1,750m incl. $500m floating); 2029 $3,005m (Feb EUR $855m 1.0%, Jun $1,000m 2.95% and $1,150m 4.425%); 2030 $1,671m (Mar $1,500m 3.35%, Dec EUR $171m 2.5%). EUR tranches at the 30-Jun-2026 USD carrying amounts.
debt.coupon_note: Weighted-average coupon ≈3.8% on $24.1bn of notes (principal-weighted, floating tranches at ~SOFR + 0.4%); Q2-26 interest expense $218m (before the full quarter of the $5.0bn June-2026 notes).

Q1-26.src: Q1-26 release (8-K 30-Apr-2026, Ex. 99.1) prints end-of-period cash, cash equivalents, restricted cash and restricted cash equivalents as 13,248 (= the beginning balance). The Q1-26 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1141391/000114139126000031/ma-20260331.htm) shows 10,764 = 13,248 − 2,484 net decrease, which also ties to the 31-Mar-2026 balance sheet (cash + restricted cash + restricted security deposits). 10-Q figure used.
